description:
Episode 234 we discuss the approaching "iceberg" (persecution) that will have to be faced in the near future. The gospel ship which is the remnant church who keep the commandments and have the testimony of Jesus, will be confronted with it and each person will have a choice to make, either stay in the ship and face the "iceberg" head on to survive, or abandon ship and face everlasting death. What does the iceberg entail and how do we face it?
